integrity: The general equality theorem is obtained by matching two support-functional lower certificates with the published weighted-James upper estimate. The classical James value of the hexagonal plane is independently reconstructed by a complete dihedral edge reduction. The bundled exact-arithmetic checker verifies the finite edge formulas and rational-weight witnesses, but finite computation is not used as proof of the continuum theorem. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The supporting-face condition is proved sufficient, not necessary. The exact application is the affine-regular hexagonal plane; the result does not classify weighted-James profiles of all polygonal or Radon planes.
title: Supporting-face saturation of the weighted James envelope
